title: Feminine & elegant — Dental Flower Studio
question: Steered toward a high-end aesthetic studio / perfume-house feeling. The roll assigned The Invitation Suite. Keep it, take the alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Invitation Suite
options.lineage: fine letterpress stationery: an invitation, a reply card, a menu card and a lined envelope
options.thesis: You are not processed, you are invited: the studio speaks in fine stationery, with each card a personal note from her.
materials: plum envelope with a patterned floral liner
options.viewport: A plum envelope fills the screen, its floral liner open, and a white cotton invitation card rises from it: a debossed flower monogram, 'Dental Flower Studio' in foil, her welcome line, and a foil-edged 'Запиши час' reply card tucked beside it.
options.risk: Stationery can feel like a wedding invitation; it has to stay clearly a dental studio, with services and prices one card away.

raised.raise: Foil is reserved for the single focused or primary element; everything else stays ink.
Every card's size comes from one proportional stationery system, so nothing is sized ad hoc.
Every treatment card has fixed furniture: a name, what it is for, visits, time and price.
Each treatment carries one plain sentence, the way she would explain it across the chair.
Each viewport is one held moment, owned by a single card.
Regular care is shown as a dated sequence of visits, not left as a vague promise.

options.label: Maison de Parfum
options.lineage: niche perfume houses: a glass flacon, a satin-lined box and the olfactory pyramid
options.thesis: The smile composed like a fragrance: top, heart and base notes become consultation, plan and lasting care.
options.viewport: A blush satin field with an enormous refined wordmark, a 'Нотки' pyramid of the three stages of care, and a slim booking line.
options.risk: It's the most familiar luxury-beauty language, and close to every high-end aesthetic clinic.

options.label: Luminescent Understory
options.viewport: A dark forest path that lights up as you approach.
options.case: Fuses poorly: dark and sci-fi, not a calm studio.
options.kept: Foil is reserved for the single focused element.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.case: Fuses poorly: it is technical, not feminine.
options.kept: One proportional system sizes every card.

options.label: Character Catalog
options.case: Fuses poorly: too childish for this audience.
options.kept: Each treatment has fixed card furniture.

options.label: Napkin Zine
options.case: Fuses poorly: too casual for an elegant brand.

options.label: Painted Hoarding
options.viewport: A leaping figure with a vertical title.
options.case: Fuses poorly: foreign to the culture and to the subject.

options.label: Coiled Tower
options.case: Fuses poorly: earthy and heavy, not elegant.
options.kept: Regular care shown as a dated sequence.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A design-forward dental studio site in the vein of Tend or Dentologie, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A soft hero headline, a booking button, a row of service cards and a studio photo strip.
canonCard.risk: It depends on professional photography the studio doesn't have, and it looks like everyone else.
